text.areas-file.mjs: Parse and load the optional .lantern/areas tree of areas and their feature leaves, with line numbers for syntax errors, and its area texts
text.areas-gate.mjs: The eight deterministic rules that judge a drafted areas tree, with every threshold a named constant and a seeded random baseline for cohesion
text.areas-propose.mjs: Derive from the map each feature's partners, feature-to-feature weights and unnamed candidate groups with the share of lines each keeps inside
text.areas-snapshot.mjs: Build the snapshot the areas helper reads (blocks, edges, outside systems, platforms, feature texts) from the map, with core blocks for untagged files
text.areas.mjs: Command line for the areas helper: propose prints the evidence for drafting areas, check runs the gate and exits 0, 1 or 2, required exits 1 when a map over the thresholds has no passing tree, lookup writes blind-lookup packets, runs one no-tools reader call per packet and scores the answers
text.areas-required.mjs: Decides whether a map is over the areas thresholds and, if so, whether its areas file and texts pass the gate; returns the reasons and the message that names step 4a
text.areas-reader.mjs: Answers each blind-lookup packet with one fresh no-tools claude call from a scratch directory outside the project, or with a stand-in command, a few in parallel with a timeout
text.areas-lookup.mjs: Builds the member-free blind-lookup packets for an areas tree and scores a reader's answers against MIN_LOOKUP, listing every feature placed elsewhere
text.areas-project.mjs: Loads the project's areas tree, its texts and the map snapshot for the areas commands, exiting 2 with a reason when unusable
text.areas-validate.mjs: Check the areas tree against the declared features, platforms and systems, and the area count, fan-out, naming and text rules, as [areas] findings
text.cross-platform.mjs: Find the platforms whose gateway files, or whose infra files, relate to no other platform of the repository, as [relations] warnings with the platform and the counts
text.check-locales.mjs: Check viewer translations, role labels and placeholder parity
text.cli-args.mjs: Split a command line into root, command, arguments and flags, optionally strict about missing flag values and unknown flags, and fail with a message and exit code
text.plan-ref.mjs: Defines the #plan record line pattern with the slug and item patterns, the plans folder and the ISO date check that the plan format and the pull-request parsers share
text.shell.mjs: Shared helpers: ordered comparison, running git with its output and error, and locating a sibling skill folder
text.enumerate.mjs: List source files selected for mapping and explain exclusions
text.fold.mjs: Move the map and text files an agent wrote under a %2Eclaude alias into the real .claude folder and remove the emptied alias folders
text.fold.mjs gotcha: Overwrites a file that already sits at the real path; the alias file is always the complete new content.
text.ignore.mjs: Read and match ordered gitignore-style include and exclude rules
text.lang-todo.mjs: List missing translations with their primary-language text
text.lang.mjs: Print the project’s primary map language
text.lib.mjs: Enumerate source files and load map structure, roles and the Claude (Sonnet, Opus, Fable), exact-id and Codex (Sol, Astra, Terra) model policy with its below-recommended advice where a family has a recommended version, with the feature-count limits and the %2Eclaude alias of a path
text.lib.mjs gotcha: The Codex route is LANTERN_PROVIDER=codex or an .agents/skills install; elsewhere a Sol id fails modelAllowed.
text.macro-eval.mjs: Print, without a model, the checks a macro view depends on: feature and system counts, name collisions, duplicate and single-use systems, every platform over the untagged share, the untagged gap between platforms of one kind, tag divergence and platforms with no relation to another platform, each PASS or WARN
text.macro-stats.mjs: Compute feature usage, untagged shares and gaps, the platforms whose untagged records need review, tag divergence between platforms of one kind and outside-system statistics from a loaded map
text.migrate-lang.mjs: Move legacy inline map prose into primary-language JSON files
text.migrate-model.mjs: Strip leftover model provenance (#model lines and model fields) from every map, section and language file of an older map in one pass
text.model.mjs: Report the Claude or Codex mapping-model policy or check a model identifier, noting a version below the recommended one
text.plan.mjs: Group mapping work into resumable chunks, report progress, name the %2Eclaude alias paths for records under a .claude folder and run retag mode's status and chunks
text.platforms.mjs: Load platform rules, assign files and validate platform labels
text.prdescribe.mjs: Parse, validate and write the describe lines of a pull-request record: what, before, after and verified texts, capped in length and count, with comment markers, cost-block lines and table rows removed, and the JSON form the sync tool accepts.
text.prflow.mjs: Parse, validate and write the flow lines of a pull-request record: stories of blocks in rows, with their kinds, limits and the record files each step points at
text.prs.mjs: Parse and validate pull-request records and the local records of branches with no pull request, dismissal lists, review order, flow and the plan items a record ticks by the shared plan reference pattern, with a step's file references checked against the record's files
text.refs.mjs: Find mapped-file reference candidates in agent instruction markdown
text.retag-areas.mjs: Rename, merge or drop the feature's leaf in .lantern/areas, and drop an area with its text when its last leaf goes
text.retag-edit.mjs: Rewrite only the feature and plumbing lines, ext relation targets and matching language keys of a map in memory, then write them together
text.retag-plan.mjs: Propose a cleaned feature and system list, list the open retag steps and chunk the records still under a flagged feature and the untagged records of a platform far above its sibling
text.retag-plan.mjs gotcha: Features used by one platform of their kind are only listed for review; they never block RETAG DONE.
text.retag.mjs: Rename, merge or drop outside systems and rename, merge, untag or re-tag features, or mark a file deliberately plumbing, across the whole map, and the feature's leaf in the areas tree, without touching a hash
text.retag.mjs gotcha: A finished rename or merge reruns as exit 0, so a mistyped old id is caught only if the new id is unknown too.
text.sections.mjs: Parse and validate project sections, evidence and translated texts
text.systems.mjs: List, check, seed, suggest merges for and add the canonical outside systems of .lantern/systems with their texts
text.systems.mjs gotcha: add refuses a near-duplicate of a listed id unless --allow-similar, and a new id needs --text.
text.texts.mjs: Load map-language texts and check keys and coverage; the areas, systems and platforms text files are read by their own checks
text.validate.mjs: Check map coverage, freshness, relations, texts, vocabulary, cross-platform relations, areas and project metadata; with --require-areas also refuse a map over the areas thresholds that has no passing tree
text.validate.mjs gotcha: Vocabulary findings only warn without --strict; cross-platform ones always warn; a malformed .lantern/systems fails.
text.vocabulary.mjs: Hold the outside-system list, the channel and generic word lists, name normalisation and the rules that flag platform- or system-named features and unlisted, duplicate or library-like ext targets
